arStrings.szText: I don't...think so. I'm the only one who escaped...but I don't feel very lucky.
I was crewing a merchant vessel, the one you see run aground behind me, hauling private cargo for a wealthy customer.

A storm rose up and blew us off course. We drifted for days…then people started to die. At night we heard screaming, and horrible noises, and in the morning…another dead sailor, bloodless and white, looking like they had stared into the Hells.
I can't bear to think of it! Please, if anything remains alive in there, you have to kill it!
